run_fit_references_cli: run the fit_references script with --config and --out-path to fit linear element references
run_fit_linref_function: run fit_linref with a config dict and output path to fit and save element references
review_fit_linref_function: review the fit_linref function that loads a training dataset and fits linear references per target
review_fit_linear_references_call: review the fit_linear_references call that accepts targets, dataset, batch_size, num_batches, and driver args
review_save_checkpoint_call: review the save_checkpoint call that persists element reference state dicts as target_linref.pt files
